# Font licences

Every font NotedPo bundles is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (full text below). Files come from the pinned @expo-google-fonts npm packages (package-lock.json). Faces marked "Latin subset" were reduced to Latin, Greek and common symbols by scripts/subset-fonts.mjs; they declare no Reserved Font Name, so they keep the family name (OFL condition 3). Families with Reserved Font Names ship unchanged.
